hypothesis: assistant-target loss may improve useful assistant fidelity relative to a matched uniform DWQ control; unproven

arms.U: one on every nonpadding prediction target
arms.S: one on reasoning, transition, final and tool_call; zero on context and padding

normalization: FP32 included-target loss sum divided by included-target count per batch; zero included targets is an error

teacher.objective: renormalized teacher-to-student KL; FP32 before temperature scaling, KL and reductions; no T squared multiplier
teacher.training_capture: separate BF16 process, full frozen contexts with cache-preserving 128-token inference chunks, file per trajectory ID
teacher.validation_capture: reuse exact work/calibration-v2-teacher targets and receipt from 5cdffc0

training.precision: FP32 optimizer parameters/moments, BF16 model scales/biases, FP32 KL
training.eligible: only affine scales/biases with bits<8; packed weights, routers, other tensors, schemas and tokenizer fixed
training.padding: none at batch one; objective tested with padding
training.checkpointing: installed grad_checkpoint on first layer wraps all 28 layers of that type; one installation per process

memory_preflight.cases: shortest full training trajectory with/without checkpoint to quantify gradient equivalence; longest full trajectory U and S with checkpoint
memory_preflight.resident_state: original parameter references, FP32 parameters, Adam state and full gradients; checkpoint states stored on disk, no detached history
memory_preflight.checkpoint_short_equivalence: relative global gradient L2 difference <=0.05 and absolute loss difference <=0.005; CUDA repeat variation is not bitwise equivalence
memory_preflight.failure: preserve failure, no truncation/replacement/detached KV fallback; stop experiment before both arms

validation.model_mode: eval; checkpoint wrapper installed; full contexts in preserved-cache 128-token inference chunks, identical to v2 eval protocol
validation.family_summary: token-weighted assistant/context/whole plus each region per underlying validation family; also unweighted family mean for reporting
validation.reference: five pristine-C repeats at U step zero and five at S step zero; every candidate must pass separately against BOTH references
validation.gain: candidate max < reference min AND reference mean minus candidate mean > max(reference range,candidate range)
validation.no_region_regression: reject if any assistant-region candidate min > reference max AND mean increase > both ranges; context tradeoffs reported but not hidden in a gate
validation.screen: empirical engineering rule, not confidence intervals; no claim of independent related variants

selection.within_arm: lowest assistant mean among checkpoints that pass against both pristine references; ties earlier step
selection.across_arms: if only one passes choose it; if both pass S must pass the same fidelity gate against best U, otherwise choose U; no candidate if neither passes
selection.reload: fresh process, five identical validation forwards; must pass both original pristine references with no assistant-region regression; failure stops behavior without fallback selection
selection.reserve: contents not loaded until candidate locked and reload fidelity/integrity passed

behavior_if_permitted.order: reserved JSONL order, same for all three
behavior_if_permitted.prompt: original task contract, named entry point, original supplied assertions; ask edit_file task.py, run_tests, then final full code
behavior_if_permitted.tools: existing calibration-v2 strict read_file/edit_file/run_tests schemas; virtual workspace, sandbox for execution; final oracle always original assertions
behavior_if_permitted.serving: existing loopback MLX-LM server, concurrency one, prefill 512, upstream thinking/template parser
behavior_if_permitted.budget: aggregate across reasoning and all tool/final responses, no retries after task failure
behavior_if_permitted.limitation: original provided assertions only; not comprehensive hidden correctness tests
